We have improved support for **Sony TVs**, **3D content**, **subtitles** on the web player, and a bunch of other fixes and improvements.

The upcoming v16 release is almost ready, we just need to get the announcement and documentation finished first, which is nearly done.

Special thanks to **Ιάκωβος Ιακωβίδης** for improving our Greek translation significantly, and @danielcamposramos for several code contributions!

This release is available via [our Patreon page](https://www.patreon.com/universalmediaserver/posts/15-10-0-173931252), and will be available here when the next release happens.

## Full changelog

### General
- Added support for setting custom colors, fonts, and positions for subtitles in the web player
- Enabled media players to automatically detect when videos are 3D, part 2 (thanks, Daniel Ramos!)
- Fixed DivX codec detectio
- Fixed WTV transcoding with missing metadata
- Fixed parsing bugs with MediaInfo
- Fixed detection of some 3D video formats (thanks, Daniel Ramos!)
- Fixed selection of wrong external subtitles in the web player
- Reduced size of distributed packages
- Fixed incorrect logging (thanks, Daniel Ramos!)

### Security
- Harden against XML XXE attacks

### Media players
- Fixed detection of many Sony TVs (thanks, Daniel Ramos!)
- Fixed Xbox 360 transcoding (#6104)

We have improved support for **Sony** and **Philips** TVs, improved how **subtitles** display, fixed **resume** video bugs, and more!

This has been the result of a lot of collaboration, and I'd like to thank first-time contributors @danielcamposramos, @Eyablg-ops, and @aik099 for code fixes, and Yaroslav Maikovych for taking our Ukrainian translation from **19% to 100%**.

We're nearly ready for our first release of **v16**, and we're very excited to share it with you.

This release is available via [our Patreon page](https://www.patreon.com/universalmediaserver/posts/15-9-0-171457684), and will be available here when the next release happens.

## Full changelog

### General
- Enable media players to automatically detect when videos are 3D (thanks, Daniel Ramos!)
- Improved size and position of subtitles hardcoded with FFmpeg
- Added log level setting to web UI (#6212) (thanks, Eyaaa.blg!)
- Fixed debugging in VS Code
- Fixed endless retries when server is not connected to the internet
- Fixed all compatible options not always visible in #--TRANSCODE--# folders
- Fixed external subtitle track selection when hardcoding subtitles with FFmpeg
- Fixed over 13 theoretical security vulnerabilities in dependencies
- Only warm up fontconfig caches for engines that are active (thanks, Alex!)
- Fixed long wait times and broken playback after seeking or playing Resume files (thanks, Alex!)
- Fixed resume entries only working until program restarts

### Media players
- Improved support for Philips TVs (thanks, Alex!)
- Improved support for Sony TVs from 2011 to current (thanks, Daniel Ramos!)

### Translation updates via Crowdin
- Ukrainian (99%) (thanks, Yaroslav Maikovych!)

We have switched the default Docker operating system from Alpine Linux to Ubuntu, which fixes memory and stability problems. If you want to continue to use Alpine Linux, you can change to the universalmediaserver/ums-alpine repository. We have also done a lot of improvements to LG TV support, with native Dolby Vision support on 2022+ models (as long as you update to WebOS 25), better TV detection, and fixed support for DTS on 2025 models, since LG has unfortunately stopped supporting DTS again after only supporting it in 2023-2024 models :/ There are a bunch of other important bugfixes for all devices which we know people have been patiently waiting for, and some more interface improvements to the web player. Thanks to everyone who reported their bugs, and also those who helped fix them. We had a great amount of community help with this release, which in the current software climate we are even more grateful for than ever! ## Changes ### General - Switched the default Docker operating system from Alpine Linux to Ubuntu, which fixes memory and stability problems. If you want to continue to use Alpine Linux, you can change to the `universalmediaserver/ums-alpine` repository - Changed Edit button to an icon on the web player - Added a tooltip to the "Media info" button on the web player - Fixed menu item saying "mark contents unplayed" instead of "mark unplayed" on videos - Fixed fully played status for files on web player - Fixed breadcrumb dropdown not showing for files on web player (#5909) - Fixed inaccessible files that are still shared being removed from local database (#5356) - Fixed being unable to assign user to group on mobile (#5800) (thanks, @rtivital and @rilrom!) - Fixed files marked as fully played despite "Monitor played status" being disabled (#5828) (thanks, @dheerajmuppalla!) - Fixed AudioAddict stability and recovery from network timeouts - Fixed "recommended" being written as "recommanded" in the Windows installer (thanks, @colinvh!) ### Media players - Added native support for Dolby Vision in MKV files on LG TVs from 2022 onwards - This is likely to be one of the last v14 releases. We are really focusing on v15 but also still working with you to fix bugs in v14.

The first v15 beta release will be out very soon, and if that goes well we can progress quickly to the first real v15 release. Thanks to everyone who has tried it so far, and we would love to get more feedback on it.

### General
- Added the ability for renderers to specify support for file muxing mode
- Fixed renderers forgetting user account assignments (#4834)
- Fixed AV1 codec parsing

- Many improvements and additions to automated tests
- Logging improvements

### Media players
- Added support for Linkplay WiiM devices (WiiM Mini, Pro and Pro Plus) (thanks, @boessu!)

body: This first v15 release is the result of 6 months of hard work to make our web UI more intuitive and modern. We have added a user switcher with support for multiple logged-in users, a mode switcher to change between the two major areas: Player and Settings, pin code logins, dynamic TV season metadata, a file media info button, rewrites of our notification and realtime code, improved memory management, and a lot of other changes to improve usability and reduce the number of actions needed to do what you want. Phew. Here are some screenshots of what to expect: ![15 0 0-a1-user-switcher](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f49fb908-1f5c-448b-955d-2027284bb5e7) ![15 0 0-a1-mode-switcher](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c2fe2506-b6c3-4b05-9471-3c465da4bcb7) The development team have been using this version for months, and while there are more changes to come, it has been very stable for us. We would love to see any opinions or ideas you have. This version is our response to feedback and reviews of UMS, and we need more feedback to guide it further. You can get it [here on Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/posts/v15-alpha-is-128425464), which is where we exclusively release feature previews. The v15 releases will start showing up on GitHub when they are stable.

## Summary
